reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Legacy resource behavior: Your existing v1 resources continue working in Crossplane v2: - Legacy cluster-scoped XRs: Continue working with claims support -…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Existing v1 legacy cluster-scoped XRs (with claims), MRs and Compositions continue working with full backward compatibility.

proposed.statement: Existing v1 legacy cluster-scoped XRs, MRs and Compositions continue working unchanged in Crossplane v2 using LegacyCluster scope.
